meta.description: Audience registry for civic/0.4 eligibility. Each audience is an (org_type AND subject) predicate over the Candid PCS facets (see pcs_registry.json). An offer's `eligible_audiences` is an OR-list of these keys: a user is eligible if they match ANY one audience, and WITHIN an audience the org_type and subject are ANDed. `ALL` is a wildcard at either facet. `ui: true` audiences are surfaced in the Offer Center dropdown; others are defined for data fidelity and may be surfaced later.
meta.facet_source: Candid PCS 2024 (org_type = OrgType facet, pcs_subject = Subject facet)
